place.name: Lauterbrunnen
place.description: Lauterbrunnen (Swiss Standard German pronunciation: [ˈlaʊtərˌbrʊnən]) is a village and municipality in the Interlaken-Oberhasli administrative district in the canton of Bern in Switzerland. The municipality comprises the other villages of Wengen, Mürren, Gimmelwald, Stechelberg, and Isenfluh, as well as several other hamlets.
